newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 18.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Parliament approves law for organ transplants from brain-dead donors.
-- Finance Ministry to stop buying bank debentures from fiscal investment and loan funds.
-- Honda Motor Co Ltd to cut production of recreational vehicles from July.
-- Finance Ministry regularly ordered special reports from banks on their loans to corporate racketeers.
-- Environment and employment are main issues to be discussed at Denver Summit.
